pattern: WAI-ARIA alertdialog (native modal <dialog>) named by its title and described by the message and countdown.

aria.value: Message and countdown ids (message only when expired)

keyboard.action: Moves between the actions (focus is contained by the modal).
Stay signed in, Sign out, or Sign in again.
Stay signed in (escapeExtends: true, default); nothing when false.

focus: On open, focus moves to "Stay signed in" (least destructive). On expiry, to "Sign in again". On close, focus returns to the element that had it.
notes: WCAG 2.2.1: users are warned and can extend with one simple action; warnBefore must be at least 20 s.

Opening an alertdialog is read by screen readers; afterwards the remaining time is announced politely only when it crosses a multiple of announceInterval and at 60, 30, and 10 seconds. Expiry is announced assertively.
Announcements go to a live region inside the modal (everything outside is inert).
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
